content:
sophia: Heads-up: AuroraCloud is prepping a joint marketplace listing and sent over a compliance packet. They included: SOC2-scoped-excerpt.pdf, pen-test-summary.pdf (redacted), full firmware images, and a completed supplier-questionnaire. Legal wants a clear publish vs restricted split + automation so we don’t massage docs by hand each time.
devin: Can we get a quick inventory of the fields in their questionnaire? want to map to our intake form and automate approvals.
lee-partner: The questionnaire is the usual: product name, data flows, SOC2 audit period, encryption at rest/in transit, 3p vuln scan dates, contact info. Some free-text answers mention internal hostnames and config snippets.
mona-legal: For marketplace public artifacts we need: 1) SOC2 controls summary (redacted PII) 2) a one-line attestation from AuroraCloud 3) a manifest with device identifiers removed. Full pen-report and firmware images remain restricted to NDA reviewers. Also we need a standard APH (access processing and handling) clause for the listing copy.
ashley-sec: Rules from sec: - Redact unique IDs (serial, hw_id, mac) and internal hostnames - SOC2 excerpt limited to control narratives (no auditor contact details) - Presign TTL = 7 days default for vendor reviewers - Store originals in secure bucket with KMS CMK and 12mo retention.
sophia: Proposal: create a small intake lambda that parses their questionnaire PDF/JSON, extracts key fields, and emits a normalized JSON for listing metadata. Then run redaction hooks before publishing.
devin: I can prototype a PDF->json extractor and a jq pipeline to normalize keys. Example jq normalization: ```bash
jq '{product:.product_name, soc_period:.soc.period, encrypted_at_rest:.security.encryption_at_rest}' aurora_q.json > aurora_normalized.json
```
lee-partner: That's helpful. Also for redaction we prefer a deterministic placeholder mapping so reviewers can correlate records across bundles. Example: replace serial with REDACTED-<hash-prefix>.
ashley-sec: Good point. Use SHA256 then take first 8 chars. Pseudocode: ```python
import hashlib
def redact_id(x):
  return 'REDACTED-'+hashlib.sha256(x.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
```
ops-bot: ops-bot: created ticket INF-8721 for presign workflow automation and added runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.internal/marketplace/aurora-presign-playbook :ticket:
mona-legal: Also need a short standard paragraph for listing copy: "Sensitive device identifiers and internal configuration details have been removed; full artifacts are available to authorized reviewers under NDA." I'll make a one-line variant.
sophia: Checklist for delivery to marketplace: 1) normalized questionnaire JSON (aurora_normalized.json) 2) manifest.public.json (redacted, mapped placeholders) 3) soc2-controls-summary.pdf (redacted) 4) attestation.pdf from AuroraCloud 5) presigned link for reviewers (firmware + full pen report) + audit entry.
devin: Example presign (aws cli): ```bash
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/aurora/aurora_firmware.tar.gz --expires-in 604800
```
ashley-sec: Require: presign generation only after access request ticket is created & owner approval. Ticket must include requester name, org, purpose, and NDA reference. Record SHA256 of uploaded object and redacted object in audit log.
lee-partner: I can collect the signed attestation and confirm the pen-test witness window. I’ll also provide a short contact list for the vendor reviewer.
ops-bot: ops-bot: recommended IAM pattern: create ephemeral role for reviewer with tight s3:GetObject scope and condition aws:SourceIp if available. Log events via CloudTrail; push summary to audit S3 prefix.
mona-legal: Approvals: legal signs off on listing copy and APH clause; we also need AuroraCloud to sign a short evidence access agreement (one-page addendum to NDA).
sophia: Timeline: Devin to build extractor + jq normalization by EOD Tue, Ashley to finalize redaction lambda snippet and hashing approach, Mona to prepare listing language and evidence addendum, Lee to get attestation and contact list from AuroraCloud. Ops to wire presign automation ticket and enforce ticket gating.
devin: I’ll post the extractor + a small example JSON in this thread when ready.
lee-partner: I’ll push the attestation by Wed noon.
ashley-sec: Once the pipeline is in place we should run a dry-run with AuroraCloud: they upload a sample package and we produce the public bundle + presign. This will be our repeatable integration checklist.
sophia: Good. Marking this thread as canonical for AuroraCloud marketplace artifact handling. Ping @sophia if anything breaks. Thanks team. :lock: :white_check_mark:
